known_blockers.detail: CLAUDE_API_KEY in .env is a user-scoped key (prefix sk-ant-usr-...). All API calls (models.list AND messages.create) fail with: 'This API key is not scoped to a workspace, so this request must include the anthropic-workspace-id header with the ID of the workspace to use.' Needs either a workspace-scoped key (prefix sk-ant-api03-...) or the workspace ID to pass as the anthropic-workspace-id header. Confirmed via direct API calls on 2026-10-16; not yet resolved.
